def design(feats) -> Design:
    import numpy as np
    from scipy import stats
    X, y, ids = np.asarray(feats.x, float), np.asarray(feats.y, float), feats.ids
    n, p = X.shape
    if not p or n < 30 or min(y.sum(), n-y.sum()) < 6 or MAX_DRIVERS < 1:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    X = (X-X.mean(0))/np.maximum(X.std(0), 1e-8)
    labels = np.asarray(feats.stratum)
    groups = list(dict.fromkeys(feats.stratum))
    B = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)]+[(labels == g).astype(float) for g in groups[1:]])
    R = np.abs(X.T @ X/n)
    def fit(A):
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(40):
            z = A @ b; q = 1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(z, -35, 35)))
            w = np.maximum(q*(1-q), 1e-7)
            H = A.T @ (w[:, None]*A) + np.eye(len(b))*1e-5
            d = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y-q)-1e-5*b)
            b += d/max(1., np.max(np.abs(d))/4)
            if np.max(np.abs(d)) < 1e-6: break
        z = A @ b
        return float(np.sum(y*z-np.logaddexp(0, z))), q, w
    def matrix(S, T=()):
        return np.column_stack([B, X[:, S]]+[X[:, a]*X[:, b] for a, b in T])
    S = []; ll = fit(B)[0]
    for _ in range(min(MAX_DRIVERS, 10)):
        cand = [(fit(matrix(S+[j]))[0], j) for j in range(p)
                if j not in S and all(R[j, k] < .95 for k in S)]
        if not cand: break
        val, j = max(cand)
        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0, 2*(val-ll)), 1) > .02/p: break
        S.append(j); ll = val
    for _ in range(2):
        for j in S.copy():
            rest = [k for k in S if k != j]
            candidates = [k for k in range(p) if k == j or
                          (k not in S and R[j, k] > .6 and all(R[k, h] < .95 for h in rest))]
            val, k = max((fit(matrix(rest+[k]))[0], k) for k in candidates)
            if val > fit(matrix(S))[0]+.5: S[S.index(j)] = k
    for _ in range(len(S)):
        ll = fit(matrix(S))[0]
        losses = [(2*(ll-fit(matrix([k for k in S if k != j]))[0]), j) for j in S]
        loss, j = min(losses)
        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0, loss), 1) <= .02/p: break
        S.remove(j)
    A = matrix(S); ll, q, w = fit(A); residual = y-q
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p) if a == b or R[a, b] < .95]
    Z = np.column_stack([X[:, a]*X[:, b] for a, b in pairs])
    Z -= A @ np.linalg.solve(A.T @ (w[:, None]*A)+np.eye(A.shape[1])*1e-5,
                             A.T @ (w[:, None]*Z))
    scores = (Z.T @ residual)**2/np.maximum(np.sum(w[:, None]*Z**2, axis=0), 1e-9)
    T = []
    for i in np.argsort(scores)[-20:][::-1]:
        a, b = pairs[i]; U = list(dict.fromkeys(S+[a, b]))
        gain = 2*(fit(matrix(U, T+[(a, b)]))[0]-fit(matrix(U, T))[0])
        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0, gain), 1) < .005/(len(pairs)*(1+4*len(T))):
            T.append((a, b)); S = U
            if len(T) == 2: break
    ll = fit(matrix(S, T))[0]; evidence = []
    for j in S:
        V = [pair for pair in T if j not in pair]
        gain = max(0, 2*(ll-fit(matrix([k for k in S if k != j], V))[0]))
        evidence.append((-stats.chi2.logsf(gain, 1+len(T)-len(V)), j))
    drivers = [j for score, j in sorted(evidence, reverse=True)
               if score > -np.log(.02/p)]
    chosen = []
    for j in drivers:
        if all(R[j, k] < .95 for k in chosen): chosen.append(j)
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in chosen[:MAX_DRIVERS]),
                  columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in S),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in T), loadings={})

            if np.max(np.abs(d)) < 1e-6: break
        z = A @ b
        return float(np.sum(y*z-np.logaddexp(0, z))), q, w
    def matrix(S, T=()):
        return np.column_stack([B, X[:, S]]+[X[:, a]*X[:, b] for a, b in T])
    S = []; ll = fit(B)[0]
    for _ in range(min(MAX_DRIVERS, 10)):
        cand = [(fit(matrix(S+[j]))[0], j) for j in range(p)
                if j not in S and all(R[j, k] < .95 for k in S)]
        if not cand: break

        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0, 2*(val-ll)), 1) > .02/p: break

            val, k = max((fit(matrix(rest+[k]))[0], k) for k in candidates)
            if val > fit(matrix(S))[0]+.5: S[S.index(j)] = k
    for _ in range(len(S)):
        ll = fit(matrix(S))[0]
        losses = [(2*(ll-fit(matrix([k for k in S if k != j]))[0]), j) for j in S]
        loss, j = min(losses)

        S.remove(j)

    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p) if a == b or R[a, b] < .95]
    Z = np.column_stack([X[:, a]*X[:, b] for a, b in pairs])
    Z -= A @ np.linalg.solve(A.T @ (w[:, None]*A)+np.eye(A.shape[1])*1e-5,
                             A.T @ (w[:, None]*Z))

    T = []

               if score > -np.log(.02/p)]
